selectedDirection: User-approved Nightworks-shaped scenery, smoke-free distant render first, separate animated Gouraud smoke.

target.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: revised production gameplay-view art target for Nightworks After Hours.
Image 1 is EDIT TARGET (the actual current course and camera). Image 2 is the defining STYLE REFERENCE: the original Nightworks game.
User correction: The volcano and its smoke MUST be real dimensional game scenery, not a static photographic matte. Make it visually much more like Nightworks, with scenery climbing up and around a mountain, and very clear contrast between playable route and scenery.
Keep image 1's exact walkable route, platforms, gaps, banking, player and camera. Restore image 2's clean stylized material hierarchy: warmly lit desaturated ochre/umber, broad cracked flat stone TOPS on the playable landings, dark blue slate cliff SIDES, simple substantial chunky weathered silhouettes, minimal small-scale noise. Golden torch pools make the playable track stand out as a connected sequence against darker cooler scenery. No realistic slate cobblestone blanket on everything.
Rebuild the surroundings as a massive THREE-DIMENSIONAL volcanic mountain landscape. Broad dark layered basalt foothills rise underneath and around the existing course on both sides. Scenery ridges climb in successive chunky tiers behind the route toward one tremendous broad central volcano with a genuinely open collapsed crater. The upper mountain has thick broad fractured rock planes, heavy ridges and a powerful asymmetric silhouette, not dozens of needle spires. A few clearly separated narrow scarlet lava rivers with orange cores follow natural descending carved channels. Bright lava stays well below or well behind the playable route. Mountain geometry surrounds the route, forming shelves, walls, canyons and deep voids that make the path look like a quarry ascent around its flank. Keep gameplay gaps visually open, with no scenery masquerading as extra walkable landings.
Smoke is a rising turbulent plume made of layered stylized volumetric billows, dark blue-purple with red-lit bases, a shape that will continuously roll, expand and drift in game. The night sky is quiet dark indigo so it does not compete. No photographic panorama. No cloud-painted backdrop. Mountain and cloud shapes are sculptural, visibly consistent with the Nightworks rock kit.
Lighting and contrast: playable upper surfaces are one to two clear value steps brighter and warmer than all mountain scenery. Darker, cooler, lower-contrast distant ridges recede into layered haze. Red molten glints and reflected light belong to the chasm and crater, not the entire screen. Excellent gameplay readability with simple strong 3D forms. Preserve the first Nightworks fantasy-platformer aesthetic rather than gritty realism. Landscape 16:10, no annotations, preserve the HUD and all gameplay objects.

panorama.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: clean ultra-wide background render of distant scenery for the Nightworks platform game, 3:1 panorama.
Input image 1 is the USER-APPROVED art direction. Render its volcano and rising quarry scenery in exactly that chunky stylized 3D-game style, but REMOVE ALL SMOKE, STEAM, ASH CLOUDS AND PLUMES. The smoke will be replaced by animated Gouraud polygons in the game.
Create only the DISTANT ENVIRONMENT: no gameplay route, no foreground platform or road, no character, no torches, pickups, crates, checkpoint, HUD or text.
At centre is the tremendous broad dark basalt volcano seen in the reference: heavy angular weathered rock blocks, broad chunky ridges, sparse large cracks, an open collapsed crater and three distinct scarlet lava rivers with fine orange-hot cores. Its summit/crater lies 28 percent of the way down from the top edge. The complete wide mountain occupies the middle 55 percent of the image width. Geologic scenery terraces rise up and around the mountain on both sides, repeating the original Nightworks rock shapes, deep blue slate vertical cliff faces, some muted brown upper stone planes. Large ledges, occasional natural arch openings and deep vertical chasms. Cliff slopes and foothills climb from the lower corners toward the central crater. Much simpler and chunkier than photorealistic mountains, no detailed gravel, no fine noisy rock texture, no needle spires.
The lava is a selective accent, about five percent of visible surface. Its separate curving lines and thin falls light a few nearby cracks and edges, while most scenery stays dark cool navy and muted plum. The playable foreground will be brighter and warmer, so keep these scenery rocks subdued. Along the bottom edge, near-dark low-contrast blue-violet rocks dissolve gently into the void. Do not fill the bottom with a huge bright lava lake.
Sky: completely CLEAR quiet deep-indigo night sky, a subtle smooth blue-plum gradient and a few very faint stars. No smoke, cloud, haze plume, steam, floating particles, lens flare or baked crater glow cloud. The crater mouth may glow, but all air above it stays clean empty sky. Plain calm sky at both side edges; compatible dark value at left and right.
Medium: polished chunky authored stylized 3D render, restrained simple texture, strong broad sculptural geology. Match the approved reference's forms and palette rather than a photographic fantasy matte. Landscape 3:1. No labels or borders.

smoke: Native PuffSystem Gouraud geometry; no painted smoke texture.
